finding.title: Trim and de-duplicate the oversized Drift-codegen coverage tests for ContentDatabase and DeviceRegistryDatabase
finding.why: content_database_companion_coverage_test.dart (855 lines), content_database_comprehensive_test.dart (664 lines), and device_registry_managers_test.dart (616 lines) all exceed AG-3's 400-line cap — content past line 400 is outside a typical agent's reliable read window, so an agent editing content_database.dart's schema is likely to see and update only part of its own test suite. The first two also duplicate each other: both assert `.toString()` (and toJson/copyWith) output for the same generated classes — TextCacheData at comprehensive_test.dart:143 vs companion_coverage_test.dart:143, and the same pattern repeats for CalendarCycle, DailyContentData, SeedMetadataData — so a column rename requires updating assertions in two places, and there's no single file to point an agent at for 'the tests for ContentDatabase'.
finding.recommendation: Split each file at natural table boundaries (e.g. one file per table) each under 400 lines, and delete the duplicate toString/toJson/copyWith assertions that exist in both content_database_comprehensive_test.dart and content_database_companion_coverage_test.dart, keeping one copy.
acceptance_criteria: `find lib test -name '*.dart' ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' | xargs wc -l | awk '$1>400'` (AG-3's proposed checker) returns none of these three files.
No test description/assertion pair for the same generated method (e.g. TextCacheData.toString) appears in two different files.

finding.title: Move core/database test files onto their AG-5-mirrored lib/ paths

evidence.quote: // device_registry_database.dart's tests split across this + _managers_test.dart, neither named device_registry_database_test.dart
// no test/core/database/user/ directory exists for lib/core/database/user/user_database.dart

finding.why: AG-5 asks for lib/a/b/foo.dart <-> test/a/b/foo_test.dart so an agent can glob straight to the right test. None of content_database.dart's 3 test files, device_registry_database.dart's 2, or user_database.dart's 3 migration-labeled tests in this batch live at their mirrored path — there is no test/core/database/content/ or test/core/database/user/ directory in the repo at all. A directory listing shows 11 more user_database_*_test.dart files split the same way outside this batch (companion_coverage, dataclass, dataclass_core, dataclass_extended, managers, managers_computed_fields, managers_computed_fields2, managers_create_update, managers_crossref_filter, managers_orderby, managers_refs), so this is a systemic pattern, not a one-off — an agent adding a UserDatabase migration and looking for 'where do I add the test' has over a dozen candidate files and no canonical one.
finding.recommendation: Pick one canonical file per lib source (test/core/database/content/content_database_test.dart, test/core/database/registry/device_registry_database_test.dart, test/core/database/user/user_database_test.dart) and either merge the split files into it, or — if size (finding 6) forces a split — keep the split files under the matching mirrored subdirectory sharing the base name as a prefix.
acceptance_criteria: An audit check over test/core/database/**/*.dart flags any file whose stem (minus _test.dart and any suffix) doesn't correspond to a lib/core/database/**/*.dart file at the same relative directory.
content_database.dart, device_registry_database.dart, and user_database.dart each have a primary test at the exact mirrored path.

finding.title: Replace DateTime.now() with a fixed clock in UserDatabase migration/smoke test setup
finding.why: 29 wall-clock DateTime.now() calls across these 3 files (6 + 17 + 6) stamp createdAt/activatedAt/stateChangedAt instead of using a fixed constant. None currently assert date-boundary behavior, so today it's inert risk rather than an active flake — but TQ-6 requires hermetic tests specifically so a later change elsewhere in the same file doesn't silently start comparing against a moving 'now' (e.g. a future staleness/ordering assertion would flake once a day near a UTC boundary, and CI's randomized test ordering would make the failure look like it came from an unrelated test).
finding.recommendation: Replace DateTime.now()/DateTime.now().toUtc() with a fixed DateTime.utc(...) constant, matching the pattern already used elsewhere in these same files (e.g. schema_v1_smoke_test.dart's DateTime.utc(2026, 1, 1) at line 258).
acceptance_criteria: grep for 'DateTime.now(' in these 3 files returns zero.
TQ-6's Pending checker (currently lib/-only via inner audit check 6) is extended to cover test/.

finding.title: Delete or wire up dead code kept alive only by its own tests: ContentResult and CalendarCycleDao's legacy methods
finding.why: grep for ContentResult/ContentLoaded/ContentNotFound outside content_result.dart finds only test/story_acceptance/epic_19_offline_first_test.dart, which constructs and pattern-matches the type in isolation — no repository, service, or provider in lib/ ever returns or consumes a ContentResult; the content DAOs in this same batch (text_cache_dao.dart, daily_content_dao.dart) return plain nullable Future<T?> instead, exactly the shape ContentResult looks built to replace per EH-2's 'convert to a value at the data-layer boundary'. Likewise getCycleForProgramAndDate/getCyclesForDate/getCyclesForDateRange in calendar_cycle_dao.dart have zero callers anywhere in lib/ (grep confirms) — only content_database_comprehensive_test.dart's 'legacy method ... delegates' tests call them. In both cases a green test suite hides that the code has no real consumer; deleting either wouldn't be caught by any user-facing behavior change, only by the tests written specifically to keep them alive.
finding.recommendation: Delete ContentResult/ContentLoaded/ContentNotFound and its test, or wire it into the content DAOs' return types if the EH-2 result-type pattern is actually wanted there. Delete calendar_cycle_dao.dart's 3 legacy methods and their delegate tests, or confirm via a repo-wide symbol search that nothing external depends on them before the next release.
acceptance_criteria: grep for ContentResult/ContentLoaded/ContentNotFound and for getCycleForProgramAndDate/getCyclesForDate/getCyclesForDateRange outside their own definition+test either returns a real production call site, or the symbols are deleted.

finding.title: Shrink 5 of 7 test/core/database files that exceed the AG-3 400-line ceiling by 2-4x

evidence.quote: /// DataClass coverage for core user_database.g.dart tables not yet covered.
/// Extended DataClass round-trip tests for the remaining tables in
/// Tests that exercise DataClass serialization methods (toJson, fromJson,

finding.why: Actual line counts: seed_manager_test.dart 794, user_database_companion_coverage_test.dart 1109, user_database_dataclass_core_test.dart 1176, user_database_dataclass_extended_test.dart 1613 (4x the ceiling), user_database_dataclass_test.dart 853 — all against the documented 400-line cap (docs/coding-standards.md:511-514, whose own proposed checker is `find lib test -name '*.dart' ... | xargs wc -l | awk '$1>400'`, i.e. it explicitly covers test/). The rule's stated cost — 'content past the window is invisible, becomes a dumping ground' — is not hypothetical here: it is the direct cause of the duplicate-coverage finding below, which sat undetected inside a 1176-line file next to an 853-line sibling.
finding.recommendation: Split each file into per-table test files (e.g. test/core/database/dataclass/account_test.dart, .../goal_test.dart, ...) each under 400 lines, or promote the Pending AG-3 checker now in warn-only mode so new growth is caught at review time before it reaches this size.
acceptance_criteria: `find learning_tracker/lib learning_tracker/test -name '*.dart' ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' | xargs wc -l | awk '$1>400'` no longer lists any of these 5 files.
Total test count/assertions for the affected tables is preserved across the split (verified by `flutter test test/core/database/` passing before and after).
